A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (stat boxes, deploy and forfeit numbers and corrected game text), meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 January 2013.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-L-jeroenwebb-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Jeroen Webb]] (November 1996): The game text changes: “any starship” becomes “anything”. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•Jeroen Webb” and a white italic “E”. The third stat box, blank on the printed card, reads “FORCE-ATTUNED”; the later slips and cards leave it blank.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
